title: Apply for a liquor approved manager licence
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a liquor approved manager licence if you plan to work as a manager of a licensed premises owned by a company or corporation.
intro: If you'd like to work as the manager of a licensed premises owned by a company or corporation, you must have a liquor approved manager licence.
who_can_apply: Hold an RSA competency card or certificate.
Hold an RCG competency card or certificate if working in a hotel or club.
Be considered a fit and proper person to manage a licensed premises.
what_you_need: A OneGov account or a MyServiceNSW Account.
Evidence of your Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) qualification.
Evidence of your Responsible Conduct of Gambling qualification (if applicable).
A National Police Check certificate, issued within the last 3 months.
Copies of the 3 identity documents used when you applied for the National Police Check.
A completed approved manager declaration form – PDF (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create an account.
Follow the prompts to complete and submit your application.

internal_links.text: Apply for a National Police Check
Apply for an RSA or RCG competency card

faqs.q: Who needs a liquor approved manager licence?
faqs.a: You must have a liquor approved manager licence if you want to work as the manager of a licensed premises owned by a company or corporation.

faqs.q: What are the basic eligibility requirements?
faqs.a: You must be at least 18 years old, hold an RSA competency card (and an RCG card if working in a hotel or club), and be considered a fit and proper person to manage a licensed premises.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a OneGov or MyServiceNSW Account, evidence of your RSA qualification, personal details, professional experience details, a National Police Check (issued within the last 3 months), and copies of the 3 identity documents used for the police check.
